verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions a Terraform or OpenTofu provider, let alone one that is vendor-maintained or actively released. AWS's documented IaC tools are CloudFormation and the CDK, which are different products and earn no credit for this story. A Terraform provider is a fair axis for a cloud platform, so the absence of evidence yields none rather than na.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, the official Terraform/OpenTofu provider is real — vendor-maintained, actively released, covering the core services I run
